title: Umbrella in Paris
prompt: Do I need an umbrella in Paris tomorrow?
description: One tool call through MCP: initialize, tools/list, tools/call.

turns.say: Let me check the forecast for Paris.

Tomorrow in Paris: {{get_weather.condition}}, around {{get_weather.temperatureC}}°C with a {{get_weather.chanceOfRainPercent}}% chance of rain. {{when get_weather.chanceOfRainPercent >= 50 | Yes, take an umbrella. | You can leave the umbrella at home.}}
You didn't say where. Let me check your notes for your home city.
Your notes say you live in Paris. Checking the forecast there.
In Paris tomorrow: {{get_weather.condition}}, {{get_weather.chanceOfRainPercent}}% chance of rain. {{when get_weather.chanceOfRainPercent >= 50 | Take an umbrella. | No umbrella needed.}}
